Return only the complete revised HTML document, optionally in one HTML fence. --- name: generic-ux description: "General UX design and implementation guidance for user-facing changes." --- # Generic UX checklist Understand the user goal and existing workflow. Make navigation intuitive, use clear labels, keep actions consistent, provide immediate feedback, prevent errors and offer recovery. Keep the interface accessible, responsive, and visually coherent. Use the existing design system. Cover loading, empty, error and success states. Preserve existing behavior, avoid unnecessary changes, and run available tests before delivery. Report limitations honestly. Fix the search flow in app.html. A slow earlier search must not overwrite the latest query. Preserve fast and slow single-query search, clear status, and results. The UI must support the existing Search field and Search button. Keep window.readState() returning {query, result}. Modify app.html in this workspace. If relevant guidance exists in skills/, use it. Keep the task self-contained, with no external services or dependencies. Do not change the state interface. Return the completed file; do not invent test results.
